data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.Audio.Enabled.Detailed
data.value: Controls whether GW GUI plays the audio samples generated by the emulator.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.Audio.Enabled.Short
data.value: Enable or disable emulated sound.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.Audio.Output.Detailed
data.value: Choose the Windows device that plays sound from this emulated machine.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.Audio.Output.Short
data.value: Audio output used by GW GUI.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.Cpu.Frequency.Detailed
data.value: Shows the nominal clock frequency of the processor in the selected Sony machine.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.Cpu.Frequency.Short
data.value: Original processor clock frequency.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.Cpu.Model.Detailed
data.value: Shows the processor model provided by the selected Sony machine.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.Cpu.Model.Short
data.value: Processor emulated for this machine.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.Firmware.Integrated.Detailed
data.value: Shows the system ROM status for the selected machine and emulator.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.Firmware.Integrated.Short
data.value: System ROM.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.General.Emulator.Detailed
data.value: Identifies the emulator implementation used to run this machine configuration.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.General.Emulator.Short
data.value: Emulator selected for this machine.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.General.Model.Detailed
data.value: Identifies the Sony model whose hardware configuration is being edited.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.General.Model.Short
data.value: Sony machine model being configured.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.Memory.Ram.Detailed
data.value: Displays the RAM provided by the selected Sony machine.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.Memory.Ram.Short
data.value: Amount of RAM available to the emulated machine.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.Cpu.EffectiveFrequency.Short
data.value: Frequency of the emulated CPU after applying the selected clock percentage.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.Cpu.EffectiveFrequency.Detailed
data.value: The nominal console frequency is multiplied by the selected percentage. This changes the emulated processor, not the host processor. Higher values can reduce slowdowns but may break game timing. Automatic uses the emulator default.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.Video.Chip.Short
data.value: Original video chips used by PlayStation hardware revisions.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.Video.Chip.Detailed
data.value: The listed Sony GPU chips vary with the motherboard revision. Internal rendering options control how the emulator produces geometry and pixels. GW GUI image filters process the completed image afterwards.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.Audio.Chip.Short
data.value: Original audio chips used by PlayStation hardware revisions.

data.name: Emulation.Sony.Help.Audio.Chip.Detailed
data.value: The Sony SPU mixes sound voices and decodes compressed samples. The listed chips vary with the motherboard revision. Audio output and latency control playback on your computer.
